limitations: Binary linear complete contiguous length-three multispectra only. Asymptotic count with \(O(n^3)\) absolute remainder; not a finite-length exact formula, a cyclic formula, or an efficient encoder.
scientific_integrity: All finite computations are corroborative only; the infinite theorem is derived from a rational balanced-flow generating function, endpoint-flow injections, and a connectivity boundary bound. An independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp asymptotic for binary trigram multispectrum capacity
